text.en: France, and then Britain, propose that Israel open a campaign in Sinai, after which they would issue an ultimatum to both sides to withdraw from the Canal and land forces there, presenting it as a move to separate the two armies while retaking the Suez Canal. Ben-Gurion and Chief of Staff Dayan want to go ahead; Mapam ministers and the diplomatic line of Moshe Sharett warn against a war of choice. The Sinai Campaign itself follows history either way; the player decides whether to bind Israel to the Franco-British plan.

text.en: Eichmann has been sentenced to death and the Supreme Court is about to rule on his appeal. After that the President decides on clemency. title.en: A constitution now, later or never?
title.he: חוקה עכשיו, מאוחר יותר או לעולם לא?

text.en: The Knesset must decide whether Israel should have a written constitution. Mapai, the Sephardim, the Progressives and WIZO propose building one gradually out of basic laws; the Religious Bloc would postpone the drafting indefinitely; Mapam and 37 members from several parties want a constitution drafted at once. The vote is in mid-June 1950.
